title: Cover Plate Quick Start

steps.glance: Place cover plate on housing with arrow to outlet
steps.body: Place the cover plate on the housing with the arrow pointing to the outlet.
quotes: Place the cover plate on the housing with the arrow pointing to the outlet.

steps.glance: Start all six M5 cover screws by hand
steps.body: Start all six M5 cover screws by hand.
quotes: Start all six M5 cover screws by hand.

steps.glance: Tighten six M5 cover screws to 3 N-m in star pattern
steps.body: Tighten the six M5 cover screws to 3 N-m in a star pattern: top (1), bottom (2), upper right (3), lower left (4), lower right (5), upper left (6).
steps.warning: Do not overtighten the cover screws; the plastic cover cracks.
quotes: Tighten the six M5 cover screws to 3 N-m in a star pattern: top (1), bottom (2),
upper right (3), lower left (4), lower right (5), upper left (6).
Do not overtighten the cover screws; the plastic cover cracks.

diagram.alt: Star pattern tightening order for cover screws

steps.glance: Check gap under cover plate edge with 0.10 mm gauge
steps.body: Check the gap under the cover plate edge with a 0.10 mm feeler gauge. The gauge must not enter.
quotes: Check the gap under the cover plate edge with a 0.10 mm feeler gauge. The gauge must not enter.

warnings: Do not overtighten the cover screws; the plastic cover cracks.
